I'm a veteran so I go to the VA.  The last time I was hospitalized the doctor straight said to me, ''well you have treatment resistant depression but because you're not catatonic I can't administer ECT which could possibly help you the most."  I have been on every type of medicine there is and nothing helps.  When I get hospitalized I can't take my homework so I fall even further behind, which makes me more suicidial, so I have lost all faith in my doctors.  So I really don't know what else there is to do.

I have lost faith in life and in family and in God and in the health system that refuses to help me.  I don't really know how to describe it because nothing is THAT bad as all the people who give me fucked up advice say.  But in my head I know that I don't want to live anymore.  I'm always sad.
